welcome.heroBadge: No install, no sign-in — just listen
welcome.heroParagraph: Echora is an immersive synced-lyrics player: pick a showcase track and instantly experience word-by-word lyrics, stage visuals, and playback controls. When you're ready, connect YouTube Music to load your own playlists.
welcome.heroKaraokeLine1: The lights rise for this line
welcome.heroKaraokeLine2: Every word lands on the beat
welcome.heroKaraokeLine3: The whole stage breathes with the melody
welcome.demoHint: "Start the demo" takes you to the showcase playlist. Already a returning visitor? Use "Open the player" above to jump straight to song selection.
welcome.demoScene1Line: The lights rise for this lyric
welcome.demoScene2Line: Every word lands on the beat
welcome.demoScene3Line: The chorus hits and the stage starts breathing
welcome.stagePreviewHint: During real playback, the lights, lyrics, and visual modes follow the music's rhythm — the above is just a quiet preview.
welcome.featureStageDesc: Word-by-word synced lyrics, AI-generated stage colors, and adjustable visual modes give every song its own breathing stage.
welcome.featureMusicDesc: Support YouTube Music private playlists and sign-in-free local showcase tracks; pick a song and step on stage.
welcome.featureInstallTitle: Install on phone, iPad, or desktop
welcome.featureInstallDesc: Install as a PWA to your home screen; every launch goes straight to song selection, skipping any intro page.
welcome.readyParagraph: No account needed — five royalty-free showcase tracks are ready. Once installed to your home screen, Echora starts right at song selection.
welcome.footerAttribution: Echora · AGPL-3.0 open source project; visual technology from
welcome.footerDataNote: Echora uses YouTube API Services. When you connect a Google Account it only reads your playlists (read-only), uses that data solely to display and play them inside the app, and handles it according to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: Echora is a local-first, privacy-focused music stage. We believe your listening habits should stay on your device. This policy explains what little data touches our systems and how third-party music services are handled.
privacy.localFirstDesc: Echora runs almost entirely in your browser. Playback, favorites, lyric offsets and theme choices are saved in localStorage / IndexedDB on this device only.
privacy.localFirstItem1: No Echora account, no password collection — we never see your credentials
privacy.localFirstItem2: Access tokens (YouTube / Spotify) stay in this browser and are cleared when you sign out
privacy.localFirstItem3: Showcase audio and transcript lyrics are served as static assets — no listening telemetry
privacy.dataWeCollectDesc: Our servers do not store personal playlists, listening history, or identifiers. The only server-side processing is the optional AI theme service, which receives only the current song title and lyrics snippet you explicitly ask to theme.
privacy.weDoNotCollect1: Your YouTube or Spotify password, email content, or private messages
privacy.weDoNotCollect2: A persistent profile of your listening history on our servers
privacy.weDoNotCollect3: Location, contacts, or device identifiers beyond what the browser provides for playback
privacy.localStorageDetail: All personal data such as recent songs, favorite IDs, volume, motion preference and language lives in localStorage. Clearing site data removes it completely.
privacy.youtubeDesc: When you connect YouTube Music, Google handles OAuth and playlist APIs directly. Echora reads playlist metadata and uses YouTube's embedded player for playback. Your Google use is subject to Google's Privacy Policy.
privacy.spotifyDesc: Spotify OAuth is handled by Spotify. If enabled, Echora reads your playlists and uses Spotify Web Playback SDK. No Spotify credentials touch our servers.
privacy.lrclibDesc: Lyrics are fetched from community sources like LRCLib, QQ, Kugou using song title/artist search terms only. No user identifier is sent with the search.
privacy.aiThemeDesc: If enabled, the serverless function /api/ai/theme receives title, artist, and current lyrics (or instrumental flag) to generate a color palette. Keys are server-side only and requests are not logged with user identity.
privacy.cookiesDesc: Echora does not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers. A minimal PWA service worker may cache assets. If you self-host, you control any additional analytics. No cross-site tracking is built in.
privacy.rightsDesc: Because data stays local, you can export or delete it anytime by clearing browser storage or signing out of connected services. Contact your music provider (Google / Spotify) to manage their retained data.
privacy.childrenDesc: Echora is not directed to children under 13 and does not knowingly collect personal information from them. Music service age requirements apply separately.
privacy.changesDesc: We may update this policy when features change. The new version will be published at /privacy with an updated date.
privacy.contactDesc: Questions? Open an issue or discussion on GitHub — source and deployment are public under AGPL-3.0.
privacy.googleUserDataDesc: When you connect YouTube Music, Echora asks for a read-only OAuth grant (scope: https://www.googleapis.com/auth/youtube.readonly) and reads only your channel name, your playlists and the video ids inside them, so the app can show and play your own playlists. Echora does not read or modify any other Google data.
privacy.googleUserDataItem1: Data accessed: channel name, playlist list and video ids (read-only — no comments, subscriptions or profile data)
privacy.googleUserDataItem2: Purpose: to display and play the playlists you choose inside the app. Never used for ads or retargeting, never sold, never transferred to third parties, never read by humans, never used to train AI models
privacy.googleUserDataItem3: Storage: access tokens and playlist caches stay in this device's browser (localStorage). Echora servers do not store any Google user data
privacy.googleUserDataItem4: Retention: deleted when you sign out, when the token expires, or when you clear site data. You can revoke access at any time
privacy.googleUserDataLimitedUse: Echora's use of information received from Google APIs will adhere to the Google API Services User Data Policy, including the Limited Use requirements.
privacy.googleUserDataRevoke: Revoking access: sign out of YouTube in the app (Settings → Privacy, which also revokes the token) or remove Echora from your Google Account permissions page.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These Terms govern your use of Echora, the open-source synced-lyrics stage. By using the app you agree to these terms and to the policies of any connected music service.
terms.acceptanceDesc: Echora is provided as-is for personal, non-commercial enjoyment of music with enhanced visuals. If you do not agree with these terms, please discontinue use.
terms.serviceDesc: Echora is a client-side player that:
terms.serviceItem1: Shows synchronized lyrics and visual stages for local showcase tracks
terms.serviceItem2: Optionally connects to YouTube Music and Spotify via official OAuth to display your playlists
terms.serviceItem3: Fetches community lyrics and allows uploading your own .lrc / .vtt files
terms.serviceItem4: Generates optional AI stage colors from song context (title/lyrics only)
terms.userResponsibilityDesc: You agree to use Echora lawfully and respectfully:
terms.userItem1: Only play content you have the right to access through your own accounts or public showcase
terms.userItem2: Do not circumvent paywalls, DRM, or terms of YouTube / Spotify / lyric providers
terms.userItem3: Uploaded lyrics should be your own or properly licensed; do not upload infringing material
terms.userItem4: Do not abuse, reverse-engineer, or overload the AI theme endpoint or lyrics search APIs
terms.ipDesc: The Echora player code is licensed under AGPL-3.0. Visual technologies from folia-major retain their original licenses. Music, cover art, and lyrics belong to their respective owners.
terms.agplNotice: AGPL-3.0 requires that if you host a modified version, you make the complete source available to users. See LICENSE for details.
terms.thirdPartyDesc: Your use of connected services is governed by their own terms:
terms.thirdPartyItem1: YouTube: YouTube Terms of Service and Google Privacy Policy
terms.thirdPartyItem3: Lyrics providers (LRCLib, etc.) each have community usage guidelines
terms.disclaimerDesc: Echora is provided without warranty. Lyrics may be community-contributed and inaccurate. Playback depends on third-party availability.
terms.limitationDesc: To the fullest extent permitted by law, Echora contributors are not liable for indirect damages, loss of data, or inability to play third-party content.
terms.terminationDesc: You may stop using Echora at any time by clearing site data and revoking OAuth access in Google / Spotify settings. We may limit AI theme or lyrics proxy usage to prevent abuse.
terms.governingDesc: These terms are governed by the laws applicable to the open-source project hosting location, unless otherwise required. For questions, open a GitHub issue.
terms.changesDesc: We may update these terms when features change. Continued use after posting the new version constitutes acceptance. The latest version is always at /terms.
terms.youtubeApiDesc: Echora uses YouTube API Services to read your own playlists and plays them through the official YouTube embedded player. By using these features you agree to the YouTube Terms of Service and the Google Privacy Policy.
terms.youtubeApiRevoke: You can revoke Echora's access at any time from your Google Account permissions page, or by signing out of YouTube in the app settings.
